_note: Visual judgements made by reading each PNG in png/ (context panel + close-up). Verdicts: correct = drawn pin text at the marker equals the candidate pin text, the element label beside it equals the candidate label, and the wire ends at that marker; plausible = consistent with the drawing but the pin text or wire is not fully confirmable; unverifiable = no pin text is drawn at the marker, or the marker/label cannot be matched in the image; incorrect = the drawn pin text at the marker differs from the candidate. Files named by stratum+index (e.g. A01, A201, B04, C02, D02).

A01.note: drawn 2 in the marker circle; label 1DK beside it

A07.note: drawn 2 while TERMPOINT number is 1: the port number is not the drawn name

A17.note: drawn 1 under the marker, candidate uses seq 1 (TERMPOINT 2)

A21.note: drawn 1; label 5KLP7; LOGGEN record has no wire handle, the drawn wire does end at this marker
